statements.content: Euclidean N=1 algebra; dotted/undotted indices switched relative to the standard (Wess-Bagger) assignment (fn.7). No sigma-matrix normalisation of P given.

statements.formula: Q\equiv Q_{\dot-},\ z^\alpha\equiv x^{\dot+\alpha},\ \bar z^\alpha\equiv x^{\dot-\alpha},\ \{Q,\bar Q_\alpha\}=\partial_{\dot-\alpha}=\partial_{\bar z^\alpha},\ (z_\alpha)^*=\epsilon_{\alpha\beta}\bar z^\beta,\ [M_{\dot+\dot-},Q_{\dot-}]=-Q_{\dot-},\ [R,Q_{\dot-}]=-Q_{\dot-}
statements.content: Twisting supercharge and complex structure; surviving SU(2) generated by Mbar_{alpha beta}; with U(1)_R, M_R = M_{dot+dot-} - R gives U(2); cohomological degree C = gh - M_{dot+dot-}.
Charges; M_R = M_{dot+dot-} - R, C_R = gh - R, C = C_R - M_R = gh - M_{dot+dot-}.

statements.formula: \bar\partial\equiv\bar\theta^\alpha\partial_{\bar z^\alpha};\ (Q+\bar\partial)\mathcal O[\bar\theta]=(Q\mathcal O)[\bar\theta];\ Q\mathcal O^{(k)}+\bar\partial\mathcal O^{(k-1)}=(Q\mathcal O)^{(k)};\ D_{\dot-}\mathcal O=(Q+\bar\partial)\mathcal O=0
statements.content: Chiral superspace with Qbar_alpha = -d/d thetabar^alpha; thetabar^alpha <-> d zbar^alpha; Q + dbar coincides with D_{dot-}; semi-chiral iff O^(0) is Q-closed; Q-cohomology = semi-chiral superfields modulo image of Q+dbar.

statements.formula: \Tr t^At^B=-\tfrac12\delta^{AB},\ \Tr t^A[t^B,t^C]=-\tfrac12 f^{ABC},\ [t^A,t^B]=f^{ABC}t^C,\ \sum f^{ABC}f^{ABD}=N\delta^{CD};\ SU(2):\ t^A=-\tfrac i2\sigma^A,\ f=\epsilon;\ Qb^A=\epsilon^{ABC}c^Bb^C,\ Qc^A=\tfrac12\epsilon^{ABC}c^Bc^C;\ b^2=b_Ab^A=-2\Tr b^2
statements.content: Killing form delta^{AB}; trace in the defining representation.

statements.content: Tree-level bracket = single Wick contraction; left derivatives; index contraction convention of App.B.2.

statements.formula: \bar\partial+\hbar\Delta_{\rm BV}+\{\mathcal I,\cdot\}_{\rm BV};\ \mathbf Q=Q_0+Q_1+\cdots;\ Q=Q_0+\hbar Q_1+\hbar^2Q_2+\cdots
statements.content: No coupling in the BF action; tau only in the total-derivative term (3.4). Loop counting by hbar; no relation of hbar to the physical g^2 or g^2 N/16pi^2 given.

statements.formula: b\in\Omega^{0,\bullet}(\mathbb C^2,\mathfrak g^\vee),\ c\in\Omega^{0,\bullet}(\mathbb C^2,\mathfrak g)[1];\ \int\mathrm d^2z\,\Tr b(\bar\partial c-\tfrac12[c,c]);\ \int\mathrm d^2z\,\tau\Tr\partial_\alpha c\,\partial^\alpha c
statements.content: Holomorphic BF theory = twist of pure N=1 SYM (identification in BV, refs [22,41,50]); changes field content, not Q-cohomology. c^(0) ghost (deg 1), c^(1) antiholomorphic connection (deg 0), b^(0) deg -2; holomorphic part of connection absent. Basic action = self-dual limit; (3.4) total derivative (instantons only).
Dictionary twisted <-> physical fields, stated up to field redefinitions at the level of free Q-cohomology. Gaugino bilinear C_0 = d_alpha c d^alpha c (glueball, fn.5).
Chiral multiplet as a 4d beta-gamma system; J = beta gamma; Delta proportional to the R-charge of Phi.
Gauged beta-gamma system for matter. With matter Tr b^2 is not tree-level Q-closed; in the SQCD discussion the stress tensor and its derivatives are not exact, at least perturbatively.

N=4 SYM twist: bc in gl(N) + three adjoint beta-gamma, superpotential Tr[gamma^1,gamma^2]gamma^3 (= Tr gamma^1[gamma^2,gamma^3]); tree-level cohomology C^*(gl_N (x) C[[z_1,z_2,eps_i]] | gl_N); symmetry: holomorphic vector fields on C^{2|3} preserving d^2z d^3eps. Tree level only; no one-loop N=4 formula in this paper.

statements.formula: \mathcal V\equiv\mathbb C[\partial^n_{z^1}\partial^m_{z^2}c^{(0)},\partial^k_{z^1}\partial^l_{z^2}b^{(0)},n+m>0,k+l\ge0]^G;\ Qc=-\bar\partial c+\tfrac12[c,c],\ Qb=-\bar\partial b+[c,b];\ Q_{\rm free}=-\bar\partial;\ Q_{\rm int}c=\tfrac12[c,c],\ Q_{\rm int}b=[c,b]
statements.content: Free cohomology V; c^(0) excluded (only derivatives); free composites of b^(0), c^(0) have no renormalisation ambiguity; Delta_BV must be regularised (fn.24). Q_int matches the categorification literature [18,19,51] with Q_{dot-}: D_{z^alpha} -> [lambdabar_alpha, .].

statements.formula: C(\varepsilon)=c+\varepsilon b,\ Q_{\rm int}C=\tfrac12[C,C];\ \xi=\partial_\varepsilon,\ \tilde\xi_\alpha=\varepsilon\partial_\alpha;\ B_{a-1,\alpha}=\tilde\xi_\alpha A_a,\ C_{a-2}=\tilde\xi_1\tilde\xi_2A_a;\ A_n=\Tr b^n,\ B_{n,\alpha}=\STr b^n\partial_\alpha c,\ C_n=\STr b^n\partial_\alpha c\partial^\alpha c;\ S_\alpha=\Tr b\partial_\alpha c
statements.content: Tree-level classes for all G; large-N single-trace basis (5.19) plus derivatives and derivatives of Tr c.

statements.formula: g_{m,n}=z_1^{m+1}z_2^{n+1}\{\partial_\alpha S^\alpha,-\},\ \partial_\alpha S^\alpha=2\Tr\partial_\alpha b\partial^\alpha c=-\partial_\alpha b_A\partial^\alpha c^A;\ g_{m,n}\mathcal O=-X_{f_{m,n}}\mathcal O;\ g_{-1,0}\mathcal O=\partial_1\mathcal O,\ g_{0,-1}\mathcal O=-\partial_2\mathcal O,\ -\tfrac12(g_{1,-1}+g_{-1,1})\mathcal O=(x_1\partial_2-x_2\partial_1)\mathcal O
statements.content: Stress tensor written 2 Tr b d_alpha c here (factor 2 relative to (3.19)); modes generate Hamiltonian symplectomorphisms incl. translations and SU(2) rotations.

Conjecture: cohomology of (3.27) = cohomology of a differential bold-Q on V (quantum-corrected Q_int). Operational definition: regularise O times exp of integrated interaction, act with Q_free, rewrite as regularisation of (bold-Q O) times exp. Q_n from n-loop diagrams. bold-Q scheme dependent; different schemes expected related by quasi-isomorphisms; convenient scheme in [26].

statements.formula: \mathcal I=-\tfrac12\Tr b[c,c];\ Q_0\mathcal O=Q_{\rm free}\Big[\int_{|z|>\epsilon}\mathcal I\,\mathrm d^2z\,\mathcal O(0,0)\Big]=\int_{|z|=\epsilon}\mathcal I\,\mathrm d^2z\,\mathcal O(0,0);\ Q_0\mathcal O=\{\mathcal I,\mathcal O\};\ \int_{|z|=\epsilon}\mathrm d^2z\,F P\to F(0,0)+O(\epsilon)
statements.content: Q_0 as a BRST anomaly from removing the interaction in a ball of radius epsilon; epsilon-independent in Q_free-cohomology; no contraction: integral -> 0 as epsilon^3; at most one contraction.
statements.regulator: ball |z|<epsilon around the operator (epsilon = radius; unrelated to the manuscript's eps)

statements.formula: Q_n\mathcal O=\frac{1}{(n+1)!}\{\mathcal I,\dots,\mathcal I,\mathcal O\};\quad \tfrac12\{\mathcal I,\mathcal I\}+\tfrac16\{\mathcal I,\mathcal I,\mathcal I\}+\cdots=0;\quad \int_{\mathbb R^{4n}}\prod_i\mathcal I(z_i,\bar z_i)\mathrm d^2z_i\,\mathcal O(0,0)
statements.content: Higher brackets with n+2 slots; quadratic axioms + Maurer-Cartan condition => nilpotency order by order (argued; [26]). Five-step procedure: integral (3.35); maximal Wick contractions with regularised propagators; Q_free and dbar by parts onto propagators; drop descendants, project to origin; resulting integrals claimed finite and regulator independent.

statements.formula: P(x,\bar x,\mathrm d\bar x)\equiv\frac{1}{4\pi^2}\frac{\bar x^2\mathrm d\bar x^1-\bar x^1\mathrm d\bar x^2}{|x|^4},\ |x|^2=x^1\bar x^1+x^2\bar x^2,\ \bar\partial P=\mathrm d\bar x^1\mathrm d\bar x^2\delta^4(x)
statements.content: Propagator = Bochner-Martinelli kernel, (0,1)-form, odd; contracts c(x) with b(y). Q_n: 2n+2 antiholomorphic integration variables, 2n+1 propagators; net c +1, net b -n; each derivative type +n.
Tree level: one internal line, Leibniz, commutes with d_alpha; Q_0 c = 1/2[c,c]; Q_0 = Q_int (up to Q_free-exact terms).

{Q_0,Q_1}=0 first nontrivial equation; Q_n linear, derivation on monomials longer than n+1; Q_1^2 != 0 => Q_2 != 0, two-loop diagram computed nonzero in [32]; U(1)_b (b:1, c:0) preserved by Q_0, lowered by Q_n; filtration makes bold-Q well defined and the spectral sequence well posed.
Perturbative cohomology defined recursively by homotopy transfer; limit U_0^(infty) is the definition (needs a filtration).

statements.formula: Q_1\mathcal O\equiv\tfrac12\{\mathcal I,\mathcal I,\mathcal O\}\ (\lambda=0);\ Q_1(f_1\dots f_i\dots f_j\dots)=\sum_{i<j}(-1)^{\cdots}Q_1(f_if_j)(f_1\dots\hat f_i\dots\hat f_j\dots)
statements.content: Only triangle diagrams (two fields of O, two of each vertex). Vanishes on single fields. Acts on pairs; respects gauge symmetry and perturbative U(2); turns one b into c, adds two holomorphic derivatives with contracted indices.

statements.formula: Q_1(b_Ab_B)=\partial_\alpha b_A\partial^\alpha c^B+\partial_\alpha b_B\partial^\alpha c^A-2\delta_{AB}\partial_\alpha b_C\partial^\alpha c^C;\quad Q_1(b_Ac^B)=(-1)\big(\partial_\alpha c^A\partial^\alpha c^B-\delta^B_A\partial_\alpha c_D\partial^\alpha c^D\big)
statements.content: From the one-loop diagram computed in [32]; open adjoint indices; the delta structure is the SU(2) one (see CK01).

No coefficient printed. d_alpha S^alpha, nontrivial at tree level, becomes Q-exact at one loop; by (3.43) higher Q_n act trivially on Tr b^2, so no further perturbative correction. Holomorphic confinement: since modes of d S include translations, holomorphic derivatives of all local operators vanish in cohomology; twisted theory topological at one loop.

statements.formula: Q_1A_n\sim n\Tr b^{n-2}\partial_\alpha b\,\partial^\alpha c;\qquad Q_1A_n=\frac{2n}{n-1}\partial_\alpha B^\alpha_{n-1}
statements.content: Planar normalisation: N^{-1} per propagator, N per vertex, single traces with an unspecified overall power of N. (5.21) after reordering by tree-exact terms (on Q_0-cohomology). Q_1 B_{n,alpha} proportional to d_alpha C_n up to tree-exact terms unless accidental cancellation (no coefficient). Q_1 C_n = 0. U(N): one-loop single-trace cohomology = C_n (no derivatives) + derivatives of Tr c; SU(N): C_n only. 1->2 traces suppressed by N^2, 2->1 order 1.
SU(2) bootstrap: unique solution of (3.41) up to three loops parametrised by C_1, C_2; comparison with (C.4) stated to give C_2=0, C_1=-2. F, G, H, K transcribed in bgkwwy.tex.
Two-loop examples forced by Q_1^2 + {Q_0,Q_2} = 0 (SU(2)).

SU(2) to M_R=14, SU(3) to M_R=8. One-loop cohomology sparse enough to forbid higher differentials in range => (8.5) exact to all orders. SU(2) representatives: M_R=2 C_0; 6 C_2; 10 C_4, B_{1,2} d_2C_0 d_1^2C_0; 12 B_{1,2}d_1d_2B_{1,2}d_1^2C_0; 14 C_6, B_{3,2}d_2C_0d_1^2C_0. SU(3): 2 C_0; 4 C_1, C_0^2.

Holomorphic counterpart of the Konishi anomaly (translation of [53]); to be recovered by a one-loop triangle. Pure gauge theory: scale and U(1)_R broken at one loop; R-anomaly ~ Tr F^F one-loop exact, supersymmetrised to the Konishi anomaly equation with Tr Wbar Wbar [28,30,31]. Holomorphic vector field shifts tau by a multiple of d_alpha v^alpha; divergence-free v non-anomalous.
Q satisfies Leibniz only for the loop-corrected product O o O' = O_{-1,-1}O'; regularised product not associative; (3.26) fails to vanish by a one-loop correction and reproduces the anomaly.

statements.formula: S_\alpha\equiv D_{\dot+}S_{\dot+\alpha}|_{\theta=0},\ (Q+\bar\partial)S_\alpha=\bar Y_{\dot+\alpha},\ \partial_{\dot+\alpha}\bar Y^\alpha_{\dot+}=0;\ \int_{S^3}f\,\partial_\alpha S^\alpha\mathcal O=-\int_{S^3}(\partial_\alpha f)S^\alpha\mathcal O
statements.content: For a classically scale-invariant theory with one-loop beta function: (Q+dbar)S vanishes classically but not at one loop; (Q+dbar) d S vanishes exactly. Pure gauge: d S exact at one loop (holomorphic confinement).

One-loop corrections are semi-chiral analogues of the generalised Konishi anomaly equations [28,30,31]; perturbative corrections cannot stop at one loop because the one-loop differential is not nilpotent; SU(2) two-loop bootstrapped.
bold-Q is scheme dependent; scheme independence expected only up to quasi-isomorphism; convenient scheme in [26].
Parametrisation of the deformation space is scheme dependent beyond first order; BRST anomaly = odd nilpotent vector field on couplings (L_infty).
Non-perturbatively the choice of path-integration contour / solution of Ward identities may be non-unique.
No explicit statement on how a finite counterterm or field redefinition changes Q_1.
U(1)_R anomalous at one loop; U(2) (SU(2) of Mbar plus M_R) formally survives in perturbation theory, broken to SU(2) by instantons; the perturbative differential commutes with U(2).
Translations of a classically conserved current can receive quantum corrections (P_mu J^mu = d_mu J^mu).
Only superconformal kinematics; no one-loop statement on S, K, Delta action on operators; no N=4 one-loop statement.
Twist = passing to Q-cohomology; twisting deforms Q_BRST by Q, regrading by U(1) in R-symmetry; T' = {Q,S} with S an operator (not a special supercharge).

Brane backreaction (U(1)_b charge -1, fn.46) produces a BRST anomaly in couplings to the brane, expected to be cancelled by the planar one-loop BRST transformations of A_n, B_{n,alpha}, C_n (not computed).
Verified for both readings of the index contraction. General-G form not in the paper.

Coefficient of (3.40) with S as in (3.19): -4 (convention independent); -2 with App.B.1 normalisation 2Tr b d c. (5.21) at n=2 gives +4 in the planar normalisation; the normalisations are not related explicitly in the paper.
